Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
January 14, 2014
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Sister Madeline Fitzgerald of
Recommended Action:
St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church *3
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
Recommended Action:
No Presentation items are scheduled. *3
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ended November 30, 2013 (CC)
C4.
2014 City Legislative Platform (CC)
C5.
Fiscal Year 2013 State Homeland Security Program Grant Award (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , accepting grant funds of $58,539 and amending the FY 2013/14 Operating Budget.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving the FY 2013 State Homeland Security Program Grant Assurances.
C6.
Street Lighting Maintenance Services Agreement (CC)
C7.
No Overnight Parking on Via Centre (CC)
C8.
All-Way Stop on North Avenue at Maryland Drive (CC)
C9.
Purchase and Sale Agreement, Transfer and Conveyance Agreement (CDC/SA)
1.
Adopt the following resolutions, approving a purchase and sale agreement for the property located at 345 N. Santa Fe Avenue sold by the Successor Agency to the Community Development Commission:
a.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2014- ; and
b.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2014- .
2.
Adopt the following resolutions, approving a transfer and conveyance agreement for the property located at 123-219 S. Santa Fe Avenue transferred by the Successor Agency to the Community Development Commission:
a.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2014- ; and
b.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2014- .
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Discussion of Public Outreach Methods (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Amendments to the Sewer Ordinance and the Sewer Service Charge Lifeline Rebate
Program (CC/BSD)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed amendments to the sewer ordinances.
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2014- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 14.12 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Control and Regulation of Fats, Oils and Grease."
3.
Introduce and adopt Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2014- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Buena Sanitation District, California, Amending Chapter 12 of the Buena Sanitation District Code of Regulations Regarding the Control and Regulation of Fats, Oils and Grease."
4.
Adopt the following resolutions, approving the Sewer Service Charge Lifeline Rebate Program:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- ; and
b.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2014- .
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
